[[File:Super Adventure Festival banner.jpg|400px|right]] [[Super Adventure Festival]] is a [[festival]] celebrated annually in the world of [[Tyria]], that grants players access to the [[Super Adventure Box]]. It is a special [[dungeon]], available to be either tackled on solo or with a group. While the main entrance is in [[Creator's Commons]] inside [[Rata Sum]], [[Portal to Super Adventure Box|portals]] for easier access have been added to [[Lion's Arch]], [[Eye of the North]], and each race's capital city as well: [[Black Citadel]], [[Hoelbrak]], and [[The Grove]]. The {{item icon|Invitation to the Super Adventure Festival}} (and {{item icon|Invitation to the Party}}) can be also used to instantly teleport inside the Super Adventure Box! == Releases == * [[Super Adventure Box (release)|Super Adventure Box]] (2013-04-01 — 2013-04-30) * [[Super Adventure Box: Back to School]] (2013-09-03 — 2013-09-30) * [[Super Adventure Festival 2016]] (2016-03-31 — 2016-04-19) * [[Super Adventure Festival 2017]] (2017-03-30 — 2017-04-20) * [[Super Adventure Festival 2018]] (2018-03-29 — 2018-04-19) * [[Super Adventure Festival 2019]] (2019-03-28 — 2019-04-18) * [[Super Adventure Festival 2020]] (2020-04-14 — 2020-05-12) * [[Super Adventure Festival 2021]] (2021-04-06 — 2021-04-27) * [[Super Adventure Festival 2022]] (2022-03-29 — 2022-04-19) * [[Super Adventure Festival 2023]] (2023-03-28 — 2023-04-18) * [[Super Adventure Festival 2024]] (2024-04-16 — 2024-05-07) * [[Super Adventure Festival 2025]] (2025-04-15 — 2025-05-06) * [[Super Adventure Festival 2026]] (2026-04-14 — 2026-05-05) === Release overview === {| {{STDT|promo expandable}} |- !
